title: B2B SEO Agencies: What They Do, What They Cost and How to Choose One
excerpt: What a B2B SEO agency does, what it costs, and how to choose one. Seven checks, questions to ask before you hire and mistakes to avoid.

meta.rl_answer: A B2B SEO agency plans and runs search work for companies that sell to other companies, aiming at qualified enquiries and pipeline, with traffic as a means, not the goal. To choose one, check its B2B experience, who writes the content, how it reports results, how it earns links, and whether you get a written scope and price.
meta.rl_takeaways:
B2B buyers research for weeks or months, so judge an agency on enquiries and pipeline, not only traffic and rankings.
Most B2B SEO agencies offer the same core services. What differs is who does the work and how well.
Prices vary widely. Published examples run from $3,000 to $68,250 a month, so ask for a written scope with the price.
Google says changes take hours to months to show. Be wary of anyone who promises a ranking date or a number-one position.
Google's spam policies list buying or selling links for ranking purposes as link spam. Ask how an agency earns links.
Many "best agency" lists are written by agencies that rank themselves first. Use them for a shortlist, then check references yourself.
meta.rl_faqs:
What is a B2B SEO agency? | A B2B SEO agency plans and runs search engine optimization for companies that sell to other companies. It aims to bring in qualified enquiries from buyers who research for weeks or months before they talk to sales.
Is SEO effective for B2B? | Yes, when it is built around how business buyers search. Buyers look for answers before they speak to a sales rep, so useful pages put you in front of them while they compare options. It works poorly when it chases traffic instead of buyer questions.
How much does a B2B SEO agency cost? | There is no standard price. It depends on the size of your site, your market, how much content you need and how much your team does. Published agency prices range from $3,000 to $68,250 a month in the examples we found. Ask for a written scope that matches the price.
How long does B2B SEO take to work? | Google says some changes show in a few hours and others take several months, and suggests waiting a few weeks before judging a change. B2B sales cycles are long, so a page may be found within months but lead to a deal later.
How do I choose a B2B SEO agency? | Start with your sales process. Then check the agency's B2B and sector experience, who writes the content, how it reports results, how it earns links, how it tracks AI search, and whether you get a written scope, price and exit terms. Compare three or four agencies on the same questions.
Should I hire an agency or build an in-house team? | An in-house team knows your product best. An agency brings strategy, writing, technical work and reporting at once. Many companies use both: the agency sets the strategy and standards and the in-house team supplies product knowledge and approves content.
Do B2B SEO agencies handle AI search? | Many now do. Ask how an agency tracks your brand in tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI answers, and how it improves what they say about you.
What should I ask a B2B SEO agency before hiring? | Ask how it does keyword research for your sector, who writes the content, how it connects search results to leads and revenue, how it earns links, who will work on your account, what is included in the price and how you can end the contract.

meta.rl_g_glossary:
B2B | Business to business: a company that sells to other companies.
Pipeline | The set of sales opportunities that may turn into customers.
Link spam | Creating links mainly to manipulate search rankings, for example by buying them.
AI search | Tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI answers that give direct answers instead of a list of links.
Scope | The written list of what an agency will and will not do for the price.
